Koo, kamala okhukhwitsila amacheni kamasila kalifundesia Abandu?
Sishikhomesinjia ta ne sishimalanga inzala tawe.
Inyanga eyo obweni bundi buliba nibunula.
Baliba mumikunda chomwikulu chia hekulu choluyali.
Koo, shibahengangakhwo ingamia shingala yaloongwa tawe?
Kho itsulisia! Katoto ewe oli Omwitsulisi butswa.
Kho Nyasaye alimuhelesia eshinyasio eshikhongo muno!
Mana khandi toto okhubalilwa amakhuwa kabu khuli khwifwe!
